Title: According to the official website of the China Earthquake Administration, according to official measurements by the China Earthquake Network, a 4.8 magnitude earthquake occurred at 11:18 on October 11, 2025 in Ludian County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan.
The depth of the earthquake was 10 kilometers.

After the earthquake occurred, the China Earthquake Administration quickly initiated a four-level emergency service response, made a video link to the China Earthquake Network Center and the Yunnan Seismological Bureau to listen to the earthquake report, and requested relevant units to conduct joint meetings to strengthen earthquake monitoring and post-earthquake trend research and judgment, and promptly report the relevant situation.
The Yunnan Seismological Bureau has dispatched field teams to the earthquake area to assist local governments in carrying out emergency response work.
